title: Aromahop OE
description: Aromahop® OE Light-stable, Cost-Effective Hop Aroma Aromahop® OE delivers reliable hop aroma to beer in a light-stable, economical format. Produced by removing alpha acids and most beta acids from CO₂ hop extract, it's variety-nonspecific versatile across brewing applications. Add it late in the boil to impart hop aroma to light-stable or traditionally hopped beers, or early in the kettle to reduce foam and improve brewhouse efficiency. Either way, the aroma character it contributes will hold up through light-vulnerable packaging — clear and green glass included. Aromahop OE can be used alongside Kettle Redi , a hop extract that delivers light-stable bitterness in the boil. Aromahop® OE Resources: Technical Data Sheet PDF Download Safety Data Sheet PDF Download

title: Citra CO2 Hop Extract
description: Citra® CO2 Hop Extract - High Oil Extraction This is a variety specific CO2 hop extract from low pressure extraction that gives a higher oil and lower alpha as opposed to traditional CO2 extract. This means that more of the delicate flavor and aroma oils are retained. Whirlpool applications are recommended to minimize isomerization and preserve the aroma. CITRA® CO2 Extract Brewing Values Alpha Acids: 53.23% Beta Acids: 17.59% Total Oils: 12.60% Viscosity: 1944 cPs (Think of honey) Available in 1kg

title: CO2 Hop Extract
description: CO2 Hop Extract - For bittering CO2 hop extract is the clean and efficient way to bitter your beer. This hop extract is made up of 60% Columbus (or other CTZ) hops for bittering and 40% blended aroma varieties. It is extremely concentrated (typical range is 50-65%, but each can is labeled with exact alpha acid) and is the better way to bitter. Dosing: Volume of extract (mL) = AAU (g) x Density of hop extract (g/mL) One-milliliter yields around 10 IBUs in 5 gallons of 1.050 wort when boiled for 60 minutes. Please note that the cans are sold based on grams of alpha and not by raw weight. Therefore the alpha acid percentage might vary, but the grams of alpha (bittering potential) remain constant.

title: Flex 2kg
description: FLEX Flowable Hop Extract (2 kilogram Jugs) FLEX® is the better way to bitter! FLEX has many advantages: 1. It is stable and can be stored for 18 months with negligible loss of brewing value. 2. Alpha acids utilization using FLEX in the kettle is better than whole hops and hop pellets; typically, between 10% and 20%, relative. 3. FLEX is extremely uniform and pourable at room temperature, with no need for sophisticated dosing equipment. 4. The alpha acids content is within a tight range, targeted at 65%. 5. Shipping, storage weight and volume are substantially reduced as only the hop’s extracted material is retained and packaged (typically less than 25% of the original hop material for high-alpha hops). From the manufacturer: FLEX® is a special formulation derived from pure hops, and its use is designed solely to provide bitterness to beer. FLEX eliminates a significant amount of the inert materials that come with the vegetative portion of hops and hop pellets, and thereby reduces weight, handling, and residual hop material that needs to be removed from the wort during brewing. The significant benefits from FLEX include its low viscosity, which allows it to be measured and dosed easily in the brewkettle, and the reduction of hop solids from wort, greatly reducing the process loss associated with the absorption of wort by the hop vegetative material. FLEX is designed for dosage early in the brewkettle boil and because the product provides hop alpha acids—the same as those found in whole hops and hop pellets—the isomerization of these alpha acids into iso-alpha acids is still necessary by means of the boiling process in the brewkettle. Switching from whole hops or hop pellets to FLEX will improve the utilization of the alpha acids for beer bittering, and the brewer can take comfort in knowing that the transition can be made with little or no effect on hop aroma. FOR DOSING CALCULATIONS AND BEST PRACTICES PLEASE REFER TO THIS PDF.

title: Hexahop Gold 10%
description: Hexahop Gold® 10% Improved Foam and Light-stability Hexahop Gold® 10% is an aqueous solution of tetrahydro- and hexahydro-iso-α-acids standardized to 10% w/w, used for pleasant, light-stable bittering while simultaneously acting as a foam enhancer, improving foam stand and cling. Hexahop Gold also works to adjust or correct bitterness in beer without harming yields and is especially effective in low BU beers. When added to beer, it will also act as an antimicrobial agent, inhibiting bacterial growth. Composition: Produced from CO2 hop extract Delivery: Supplied in tightly sealed polyethylene containers (20 kg) Application: After fermentation before final filtration Shelf life: 2 years (when stored properly) Availability: 1kg size is made to order and requires additional lead time. title: Hop Hash
description: Hop Hash - Highly Concentrated Lupulin Hop Hash is an extremely potent form of hops that is the result of the pelletizing process. Hop Hash is a raw and unpolished product that is collected by hand from the pelletizer. Hop Hash is highly concentrated lupulin , but varies widely in consistency and form, ranging from a fine powder to sticky, oily clumps. Hop hash is perfect for dry-hopping and is great for adventurous brewers who want to kick their IPAs up a notch or two. Hop Hash Intensity: 11/10 Because hop hash varies so widely, it is not tested for any of its brewing values. Which is why we recommend using it on the cold side so that you don't pull out any unwanted bitterness. Hop Hash is only available while the pellet mills are running after harvest and is very limited . So get it while you can, before we are out for the year! Sold in 4oz and 16oz increments, with limited stock for the 1 pound size.

title: INCOGNITO
description: Incognito® Hop Extract for the Whirlpool Incognito® from John I. Haas is a 100% all-natural hop product crafted to deliver highly concentrated flavor while maximizing brewing efficiency and reducing process loss. The more pellets you use, the more beer you lose in the process — but it's easier than ever to brew hop-forward beers with Incognito®. When used in the whirlpool, it boosts efficiency and contributes impactful hop varietal flavor that brewers want without the process loss. No vegetative material Flowable at ambient temperature Available in 1kg and 2kg jars with 10kg jugs available by special order. Available in 16g and 160g sachets Incognito® Usage + T90 Replacement: Generally a 1:6 replacement ratio. Usage is 1g/L INCOGNITO in the whirlpool is equivalent to 1.5lb/bbl pellets (5.8g/L). The maximum recommended dose is 2g/L. Incognito® Brewing Tips: - 1g of weight is roughly equivalent of 1ml of volume - Each 20g jar is roughly the equivalent of 4oz of T90 pellets hops in the whirlpool - Flowable at room temp, but you can wrap it in a warm towel or place the jug in warm water to lower the viscosity and improve portability. “I think Incognito is going to change the way that people brew.” Dave Colt, Co-Founder & Head Brewer, Sun King Brewing Co Additional Resources: Incognito® Spec Sheet Incognito® General Description & Application Resource (PDF) Brewer Q&A with Ross Koenigs from New Belgium

title: IsoHop
description: Isohop® Natural Bitterness Control Isohop® is an aqueous solution made of pure iso-α-acids from CO₂ extract, standardized to 30% alpha acids. With no hop aroma and clean bitterness, Isohop is designed to be used during the filtration process to correct or adjust bitterness that may have been under-hopped in the kettle. When added to beer, it will also act as an antimicrobial agent and inhibit bacterial growth. When hopping doesn’t go according to plan, Isohop will help get your beer back on target. Composition: Produced from CO 2 hop extract Delivery: Supplied in tightly sealed polyethylene containers (20 kg) Application: After fermentation before final filtration Shelf life: 2 years (when stored properly) Availability: 1kg and 10kg sizes are made to order and requires additional lead time. title: Kettle Redi | Light-stable Bitterness
description: Kettle Redi Light-stable Bitterness Kettle Redi® is the better way to bitter your beer for fun in the sun. Kettle Redi® can be used to completely replace your bittering addition and results in more efficiency as well as light stability. Beers brewed with Kettle Redi® no longer are at risk of being "light struck" and developing that unpleasant skunkiness. Kettle Redi® is sold in 1kg cartons, but is made-to-order so requires additional lead time. From the manufacturer: Purpose: Kettle Redi® is prepared from CO 2 extract and contains rho-iso- α -acids in their free-acid form along with soft resins and hop oils. Kettle Redi® can be used as a complete replacement for normal kettle extract. Kettle Redi® is an alternative to CO 2 extract resulting in higher bitterness efficiency by replacement of hops, pellets, or extract in the kettle. Properties are generally similar to conventional CO 2 extract but provide utilization improvements similar to pre-isomerized kettle products with added protection against light-struck flavors when used as the sole source of hop-derived bittering or in combination with other light-protected hop bittering products. The product is classified as a modified hop extract that may be safely used in beer in accordance with US FDA regulation 21 CFR 172.560 (b)(1). Kettle Redi Specifications: Description: A homogeneous solid paste of the free acid form of reduced isomerized α -acids, β -acids and hop oils. The color can vary from amber to brown. Rho-iso- α -acids: 38 – 42 % Iso- α -acids: < 0.3 % α -acids: < 0.1 % (below the detection limit) β -acids: 1 – 5 % Hop oils: 12 – 20 % Density: 900 – 1,100 kg.m 3 Viscosity approx. 1 – 3 Pas at 30 – 40 °C (86 – 104 °F) Storage Temperature: 4 -10 °C (39-50 ° F) Storage: Kettle Redi® should be stored in full, closed containers below 4 -10 °C (39-50 ° F). When stored at recommended conditions it is best if used within 24 months of the date of production. Opened containers should be used within a few days. What Brewers Are Saying About Kettle Redi “Kettle Redi ® helps us to achieve consistently great results in our beer. It’s extremely easy to use, easy to dose, and provides excellent protection against light-struck flavor. Because of its unique formulation, Kettle Redi ® provides us with efficiencies that result in better yields during the brewing process. I'm very happy that we have this product.” — Lincoln Jhones Rodrigues, Head Brewer, Cervejaria Bamboa, Campo Grande, Brazil Kettle Redi Resources: Technical Data Sheet PDF Download Safety Data Sheet PDF Download John I Haas Product Page for Kettle Redi

title: PHA Hop Extract
description: PHA® Hop Extract Precision in Hop Aroma Created by BarthHaas , PHA® is a lineup of fully soluble, 100% hop-derived aroma extracts designed for year-over-year consistency, versatile flavor control, and ultimate creativity. Completely free of alpha acids, PHAs offer building blocks of flavor and aroma design to complement both traditional and advanced hop additions in brewing. Made for easy dosing with no special equipment required, PHAs can be added post-filtration and prior to packaging. Overall, they help streamline complex production processes by giving brewers greater creative control and more options for flavor optimization. PHA® Classics lift aroma and flavor of any beer from hops' most recognizable attributes. PHA® Topnotes enhance beers with variety-specific aroma, good for beers that need that “late hop” boost. PHA® Classics Water-based is similar to PHA® Classics, but created for those who’d prefer to avoid other natural carriers like PG or ethanol. With signature emulsification technology, hop extracts carefully combine with water to deliver consistently targeted flavor profiles. Availability: Some varieties require additional lead time. Reach out with any time-sensitive requests. Main Benefits of PHAs: Consistent flavor control — they can even mask off flavors. Reclaim your innovative edge by creating custom hop flavors while minimizing loss and complex processing. Customizable and endlessly flexible, ideal for brewers seeking cost-effective ways to diversify their beer lineup. No adverse effects: PHAs are light-stable and do not increase beer haze or reduce beer foam stability. If you're interested in Technical Data Sheets, Safety Data Sheets and other PHA® documentation, click here for the BarthHaas Download Center.

title: PRYSMA Hop Extract
description: PRYSMA Hop Extract Impactful Flavor, Lasting Freshness New from BarthHaas , PRYSMA™ is a flowable, liquid hop flavor platform that utilizes a unique, 100% hop-derived carrier technology. No bitterness, no resinous notes, all variety-specific flavor. Full customization is possible with PRYSMA’s stable, fully-dispersible flavor that can be dosed at any time in the brewing process. PRYSMA provides potent, long-lasting hop flavor that can reduce the need for dry hopping, adding impact with minimal loss. PRYSMA enables late-stage differentiation of single base beers, helping to streamline production, reduce complexity, and scale up easily. One product, multiple applications, limitless flavor utility. Main Benefits of PRYSMA: 100% hops, 100% dispersible. PRYSMA’s hop-derived carrier technology allows brewers to add potent, fully-dispersible flavor with speed and repeatability. Built-in flavor consistency. True-to-type flavor with limited variation and lasting freshness, available in 5 varieties. Flexible dosing and customization. PRYSMA is highly flexible and simple to dose in any stage of the brewing process, giving brewers both creative control and operational efficiency. Available in 5 varieties, with more on the way: Cascade, Citra®, Eclipse®, Galaxy®, Mosaic® What brewers are saying about PRYSMA: “The implementation was super easy. We are used to adding different products during lagering—with Prysma, it is just the same via a keg. The product has a good flowability, which makes it very easy to dose, and the outcome is great. It is way less chemically and has more depth than comparable products.” - Daniel Schappert / Jopen Brewery PRYSMA Resources: PRYSMA Product Overview PRYSMA White Paper from BarthHaas PRYSMA Technical Data Sheet PDF PRYSMA Safety Data Sheet PDF

title: Redihop
description: Redihop® Protection from Light-struck Flavor Redihop® is a modified hop extract designed for bittering while providing protection from light-struck flavor. An aqueous solution made of pure rho-iso-α-acid, Redihop delivers a smooth, soft bitterness with about 60% less bitterness than traditional iso-alpha acid extracts. Whether added to wort or beer, Redihop will act as an antimicrobial agent and reduce the chances of bacterial growth during fermentation. Composition: Produced from CO 2 hop extract Delivery: Supplied in tightly sealed polyethylene containers (1 kg or 20 kg) Application: Typically after fermentation before final filtration, although it can be added to the kettle Shelf life: 2 years (when stored properly) Redihop® Resources: Technical Data Sheet PDF Download Safety Data Sheet PDF Download
